name: Duty-standby ventilation fan selection
summary: Assigns the available room ventilation fans to the documented duty and standby roles.
description: Assigns the available room ventilation fans to the documented duty and standby roles. Ventilation control coordinates the equipment that manages heat and air movement in an electrical room. A temperature request, a fan command and proof of airflow are separate signals, and the room design determines how they interact.

In a switchroom containing transformers and auxiliary panels, the room controller can supervise fan availability and send an alarm when the documented ventilation duty is not achieved. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Fan availability” at the input and “Duty-fan selection” at the output. A standby fan does not prove adequate airflow.

Identify the monitored space, the selected ventilation mode and the equipment feedback. Avoid inferring airflow, temperature limits or a fire response from a generic fan symbol; these require the room-services design.
